mainProject.title: Cogan
mainProject.lede: A system for preparing and checking complex document packages: from the requirements of normative acts to a finished PDF and DOCX. An AI agent works through all of it, and every change it proposes waits for a person.
mainProject.accessNote: Runs in production for a client. The demo is a separate sanitized copy; its login is in my cover letter, or just ask me.
mainProject.boundary: Document preparation, not autonomous compliance or final expert approval.

agent.title: Cogan AI: an agent, not a chatbot
agent.body: It knows which page you are on, opens the tools it needs and takes a link to any place in the product. Its result is a checked proposal you accept, edit or reject. Its own harness runs it in a sandbox with a fresh database per attempt and judges the final state.

ai.title: AI in every action
ai.body: 25 AI actions across six areas: reading tables and formulas from images, comparing against a scan, clause applicability, check verdicts, coverage, rules from acts. Each has its own versioned prompt, model, limit and switch in one console.

formatting.title: Data apart from appearance
formatting.body: Blocks hold the content; a Formatting decides how it lands on the page. The product knows no standard: GOST is one Formatting among others, with inheritance and a source for every rule. One set of data builds both PDF and DOCX with native Word styles.

templates.title: Projects on versioned Templates
templates.body: A Template is the make-up of a package: documents and sections, each with an obligation, a condition and a basis in an act's clause. Published versions never change. A project moves to a new one through preview, shadow run and activation, with rollback.

library.title: A library of acts and clauses
library.body: Acts live in a shared library with editions and validity periods. Each is cut into clauses, conditions and sub-items; a person accepts them and sets the question each one asks of a package. Templates, Formattings, checks and Cogan AI's citations all draw on them.

extraction.title: Extraction you can correct
extraction.body: A separate worker reads tables, formulas, scans and page positions with Docling and OCR. Corrections are a journal over an untouched original, and a review decision goes stale when its content changes. This loop could become a product of its own.

release.title: From package check to frozen release
release.body: The check list is built from accepted clauses and the Template, with its price shown up front. It finds gaps and numbers that disagree, and says why it could not check something. Once a person confirms, the package freezes into a hashed revision.
